name: Felstalker Hoof
summary: In Durotar's Valley of Trials, young shaman face demonic felstalkers as a test of readiness. Their hooves are brought to Canaga Earthcaller before they learn to commune with the earth spirits.

sections.title: A Shaman's Trial
sections.body: Canaga Earthcaller sends young shaman against the demonic taint threatening Durotar. The Burning Blade Coven lies north in the Valley of Trials, where felstalkers roam among the coven's vile familiars. Taking a felstalker's hoof tests a shaman's endurance, resolve, and spirit. Those who subdue the beasts prove ready to receive the secrets of the earth and prepare the ceremonial sapta for communing with elemental spirits.

faq.q: What is the Felstalker Hoof used for?
faq.answer: You bring two Felstalker Hooves to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials. They prove a shaman initiate has the strength and spirit to begin communing with the earth element.

faq.q: Where do these hooves come from?
faq.answer: The hooves come from demonic Felstalkers inside and around the Burning Blade Coven, in the northern Valley of Trials in Durotar.
Canaga Earthcaller, the shaman trainer near the Den in the Valley of Trials, asks for the hooves during the Call of Earth rite.

faq.q: Can any adventurer collect these hooves?
faq.answer: Shaman undergoing elemental initiation seek Felstalker Hooves. Warriors, warlocks, and rogues face their own trials in the valley and have no need for them.

angles.text: As a shaman, you begin your path toward communion with the earth spirits by slaying demons and gathering their hooves. The trial tests the patience and stubborn resilience you need to wield an Earth Totem.
Demonic felstalkers in Durotar's training grounds remind the Horde that the Burning Blade's corruption still lingers on its lands.
